# #416 — PROV-7: reflex pointer recall, body-free

State: OPEN
Author: rodaddy
Labels: none

Updated: 2026-07-25T23:37:25Z

Part of #409.

Port reflex pointer recall: request building, v1 envelope validation, pointer projection, scope validation, structural source refs.

This is the body-free path - it returns resolvable pointer identities, never content. That property is a security boundary, not a nicety.

## Scope
- ~12 functions currently inlined in the 1,954-line monolith, split into small flat modules.
- Bounded query length, bounded prior-context items.

## Acceptance
- A test proves no body, query, or content field can appear in a reflex result.
- Out-of-scope pointers are dropped, and the drop is logged (silence is a signal).
- Malformed envelopes produce a named failure, not a generic one.
- Bounds are enforced and tested at their limits.

## Non-goals
Changing the reflex wire contract.
